the isothermic behavior of proteins on HIC media is a dynamic and salt-concentration-dependent process.
the isotherms of proteins on HIC media could shift from Freundlich type to Langmuir type when the salt concentrations increased to some extent.
the salt concentration at which the isotherms shift from Freundlich type to Langmuir type could be used as a criterion for the selection of salt concentrations in protein separation by HIC.
